title: Hollow Signal
preview: You're just a hollow signal / bouncing off the walls I built...
full:
You're just a hollow signal
Bouncing off the walls I built
I kept the frequency on
But the channel never filled

I tuned in through the static
Hoping you'd come through
Just a hollow signal now
Where I used to find you

[CHORUS]
Hollow, hollow
Echo in the dark
Hollow, hollow
You left your mark
But marks don't speak
And I don't sleep
Just hollow signal
Running deep
collab_note: Looking for a vocalist with a smoky alt/indie voice. Open to genre interpretation.

title: Neon Cathedral
preview: In the neon cathedral / where the stained glass bleeds light...
full:
In the neon cathedral
Where the stained glass bleeds light
I kneeled at the altar
Of your electric night

The hymns are distorted
The choir's made of code
And I keep on confessing
To a god that I don't know

[CHORUS]
Neon cathedral
Pray to the glow
Neon cathedral
Everything we know
Is burning so bright
It looks like faith
Neon cathedral
Holy mistakes
collab_note: Ethereal vocals, think FKA twigs energy but open to interpretation. Demo track available.
